tests/vendor — what this package is held to, vendored as published.

fhirpath.g4        FHIRPath 3.0.0's grammar, https://hl7.org/fhirpath/fhirpath.g4, retrieved
                   2026-11-26 (it was N1's, http://hl7.org/fhirpath/N1, until then). parser/grammar.rkt
                   is its translation to brag.
tests-fhir-r4.xml  HL7's FHIRPath suites for FHIR R4 and R5, from the FHIR test cases
tests-fhir-r5.xml  (github.com/FHIR/fhir-test-cases). FHIRPath 3.0.0's own archive
                   (https://hl7.org/fhirpath/tests.zip, its r4/tests-fhir-r4.xml) is older: 682 tests,
                   all but 5 of them among these 935, and not well-formed XML (line 760); it is not
                   vendored. Its five are covered by tests/fhirpath3-test.rkt's checks or by the
                   suites here under other names.
ucum/              UCUM's functional tests (github.com/FHIR/Ucum-java).
